benefits.name: 2% Sam's Cash
benefits.instructions: Earned automatically on in-club purchases, including Scan & Go and Curbside Pickup; not on shipped or delivered online orders. Yearly cap: $500 on Sam's Club's pages, reported as $750 since May 2026.
benefits.source_excerpt: Plus members earn 2% Sam's Cash on their in-club purchases, up to $500 a year
